models.name: todo_users
models.description:
User profile information for single-device personal task management.

Stores basic user information entered during initial welcome screen setup. Each user represents the current device's user profile, with no external authentication required. This model supports the single-user experience by tracking name, email, and derived username for task organization.

The model assumes a single user per device with no session or login functionality, keeping the application minimal as required.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: User's email address used for profile identification. Must be unique across all users.

plainFields.name: username
plainFields.description: Derived username based on email. Format: first.last from email address.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user profile was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to the user profile.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user profile was soft-deleted (if applicable).

models.name: todo_tasks
models.description:
Todo items created and managed by the user for personal task tracking.

Stores individual task items with their titles, completion status, and creation timestamps. Each task belongs to a user profile and follows the minimal requirements of having a title (3-200 characters) and a completion flag.

Tasks are managed independently with no categories or due dates, matching the application's focus on simplicity. Tasks automatically disappear from the active list when marked complete.

foreignFields.name: todo_user_id
foreignFields.description: User who created the task. {@link todo_users.id}

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Task title as provided by the user. Must be between 3-200 characters.

plainFields.name: completed
plainFields.description: Indicates if the task is completed. True = completed, False = pending.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the task was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to the task.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the task was soft-deleted (if applicable).
